objective.title: Profitability x Accruals signal discovery
objective.description: Discover symbolic equity-return signals that use both themes (profitability and accruals) for Profitability x Accruals. The signal should capture an interaction beyond an isolated single-theme effect. Economic story: Profitable firms are more credible when profits are backed by cash rather than accrual accounting. The task is to find signals where accrual quality separates durable profitability from earnings that are likely to reverse.
